finalText:
Fixed it. The flat coupon amount was being subtracted in USD from a total that had already been converted to the target currency. The fix converts the coupon amount to match the customer's currency before subtracting.

The change in `src/services/pricing.js` now converts flat coupons to the target currency (e.g., $10 USD becomes 9 EUR at 0.9 rate) before subtracting from the order total. All five tests pass — the specific issue with flat coupons in non-USD currencies, plus the percent coupon and USD cases, all work correctly now.
